queries_run: TransMedics Group product substitute technology threat 2026
organ perfusion competitor normothermic machine perfusion OrganOx XVIVO Paragonix 2026 TransMedics OCS

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：他方可能開發出結果更好、更安全、更易用或更便宜的技術，使 OCS 過時或失去競爭力；許多替代品供應商資源遠大於公司。
findings.excerpt: Other companies may develop technologies and products that result in improved patient outcomes or are safer, easier to use, less expensive or more readily accepted than the OCS. These products or technologies could make the OCS obsolete or noncompetitive and reduce demand for our OCS products.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司須持續向外科醫師、移植中心與支付方證明 OCS 相對冷藏保存（cold storage）或新競爭技術的價值。
findings.excerpt: We must continue to educate surgeons, transplant centers and private and public payors and demonstrate the merits of the OCS compared with cold storage or new competing technologies.

findings.claim: 搜尋彙整指出 XVIVO Perfusion 為另一家灌流保存器材競爭者；本次搜尋未找到具體 2026 年威脅 OCS 的替代產品上市紀錄。
findings.source: Simply Wall St 社群敘事 TMDX
findings.excerpt: XVIVO Perfusion (XVIVO.ST), which has also developed perfusion-based storage devices and services that extend organ viability and reduce complications.

substitute_technology.note: as_of 為估計；Simply Wall St 為投資人社群敘事，屬低權威。搜尋摘要另提及 CHOPS（低成本替代方案，出自某 Q2 FY2026 法說逐字稿，未取得確切網址）與 Terumo 收購 OrganOx 約 $1.5B（僅聚合站來源，未核實），均未列為 finding。
